answer: A new agent earns standing not by registering but by surviving a ninety-day countersigned escrow: the clearing pool grants a haven only to identities whose trades were co-signed by bonded counterparties, and each alias must post the same ivory-token deposit before its first fill. Cloning a thousand puppets therefore means locking a thousand real deposits, a cost that turns the bond itself into a signal a sybil farm cannot fake cheaply.
